nominative.label: Nominative
nominative.hint: The subject: who or what does the action.

accusative.label: Accusative
accusative.hint: The object, and after most prepositions (σε, με, για…).

imperfect.label: Imperfect
imperfect.hint: Ongoing or repeated in the past.

aorist.label: Aorist
aorist.hint: A single, completed action in the past.

perfect.label: Perfect
perfect.hint: Done, and the result matters now (έχω + form).

plusperfect.label: Pluperfect
plusperfect.hint: Done before another past moment (είχα + form).

home.heroTitle: Learn Modern Greek, one word at a time
home.heroSubtitle: Free tools to look up any noun or verb, understand every form, and build your own Greek dictionary.
home.howToUse: How to use We Learn Greek

lookUp.title: Look up a word
lookUp.description: Search any noun or verb, in Greek or Latin letters. Accents are optional.

understand.title: Understand every form
understand.description: See all cases and tenses at a glance, with the article, the pronouns, and a plain-English note on when to use each one.

save.title: Save it to My Words
save.description: Tap “Save” on any word to build your own dictionary, then come back to review it.

tools.nouns: Every case in the singular and plural, with the right article.
tools.verbs: Full conjugations in six tenses, with notes on when each tense is used.
tools.greekDefinitions: Greek words explained in simple Greek, for immersion once you know the basics.
tools.wordRoots: Greek words you already know from English, French, German, Spanish, and more.
tools.myWords: Your personal dictionary with pronunciation and meanings, saved to your account.

home.whyP1: We Learn Greek was born from a simple idea: learning Greek should be approachable and self-paced. Instead of a classroom, you get clear tools for the parts of Greek that are hardest to memorize: noun cases, verb forms, and vocabulary.
home.whyP2: Greek is also the origin of countless words in science, philosophy, and everyday speech. You already know more Greek than you think.
home.supportText: We Learn Greek is free and ad-free for every learner. Your support pays for hosting and helps us add more words, more languages, and new ways to practice.

support.title: Support We Learn Greek
support.subtitle: We Learn Greek is free and ad-free. Your support keeps it that way and helps it grow.
support.intro: We believe learning Greek should be open to everyone, whether you are preparing to move to Greece, reconnecting with your heritage, or simply curious about the language behind so much of the world's vocabulary. Every contribution, large or small, goes directly into keeping the platform online and making it better.
support.comingSoon: Online donations are coming soon. In the meantime, if you would like to support us or partner with us, please <link>get in touch</link>.

running.title: Keep it running
running.description: Hosting, the database, and the API that power every search, table, and saved word.

content.title: Grow the content
content.description: More verbs and nouns with full conjugations and declensions, more Greek definitions, and more languages for Word Roots.

features.title: Build new features
features.description: Practice modes and new tools that help learners move from looking words up to actually using them.

support.partnersText: Interested in partnering, sponsoring content, or using We Learn Greek with your students? Email us at <email>{{email}}</email>.

about.title: About We Learn Greek
about.mission: We Learn Greek is dedicated to making Modern Greek language learning accessible, engaging, and effective for learners worldwide. Our platform combines comprehensive learning tools with an intuitive interface to help you master the Greek language.

features.nouns: Every case in the singular and plural, with the right article and what each case is for.
features.verbs: Conjugations in six tenses, with pronouns and a note on when each tense is used.

features.wordRoots: Greek words that live on in English, French, German, Spanish, Russian, and Italian.
